name: Teardrop Leaves
description: A repeating teardrop leaf motif in a mixed ink palette.

code.style: --rule: ( background-color: var(--color1); background-image: @doodle( :doodle { @grid: 1 / 3000px; transform: scale(1.5) rotate(45deg); } background-size: 50px 50px; background-image: @doodle( :doodle { @grid: 8x1 / 90%; border-radius: 0% 60%; } position: absolute; border: 1px solid var(--color2); visibility: hidden; @random(${shapeFrequency}) { visibility: visible; } @nth(1) { border-radius: 0% 60%; } @size: calc(100% - 100% / @size * (@i - 1)); background: linear-gradient( 45deg, @stripe(transparent, var(--color2) 1px, transparent) ); ); ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
